blocks.value: A Bar Chart provides more information than a Line Chart. It shows the Open, High, Low and Close prices for each trading period.

Imagine This: Instead of only knowing your exam's final score, your teacher also records your starting practice score, highest mock test score, lowest score and final exam score. A Bar Chart tells a similar story about a stock.
Each vertical bar represents one trading period and shows how much the price moved during that time.
A daily bar represents one full trading day. A weekly bar represents one entire week.
Bar charts contain more information than line charts but are still relatively simple to understand.
